meta.value:
"""Final bowling ranking, focused on RR's biggest bowling gaps (replaces the blended bowling score of s41/s42; batting unchanged).
Inputs: gap_parts_bowling.parquet and gap_moments.csv (s46), final_rank.csv (eligible pool, s41), evidence.csv (s44).
- Moments: the 24 bowling moments where RR are worse than both the league and the champions; W24 dropped (champions worse than the league there too) -> 23.
- Weight of a moment = RR's wins lost a season there, so the big leaks (close games 0.74, overs 16-18 close game 0.49, overs 16-18 0.44) dominate.
- Overlaps kept: a bowler good in close games at the death is credited in each of those linked moments ("fix one, fix the others").
- A bowler's value in a moment = plain runs saved per ball v the league (same moment and format; wicket = 8 runs; 2026 x1.0, 2025 x0.6, T20I x0.8),
  shrunk with 60 balls of average play, and counted only if he bowled 30+ balls there (a bowler who doesn't do that job doesn't fix it).
- Moments tied to one bowler type (e.g. close game v right-arm pace) count only for bowlers of that type.
- gap_score = weighted average over the moments he can bowl, runs saved per 100 balls. fixed_share = share of RR's lost wins in moments where he beats the league.
- Order: proven = s44 evidence check passed, gap_score > 0 and fixed_share >= 0.2 (fixes at least a fifth of RR's lost bowling wins); then helps in too few gaps; then not proven. Settings checked at 20/30/40 balls and 60/100 shrinkage."""
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json, pathlib
W = pathlib.Path("/home/claude/work"); O = pathlib.Path("/home/claude/dash15"); O.mkdir(exist_ok=True); CODE = pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text()
G = pd.read_csv(W / "gap_rank.csv"); A = pd.read_csv(W / "gap_moments.csv"); AM = pd.read_csv(W / "all_moments.csv").set_index("id")
P = pd.read_parquet(W / "gap_parts_bowling.parquet"); KM = A[(A.side == "bowling") & A.kept].set_index("id")
TY = ["Right-arm pace", "Left-arm pace", "Off-spin", "Left-arm finger spin", "Leg-spin", "Left-arm wrist spin"]
KM["type"] = KM.label.map(lambda s: next((t for t in TY if t in s), None))
mb = pd.read_parquet(W / "moment_balls_bowling.parquet"); BT = mb.groupby("pid").btype.agg(lambda x: x.mode().iat[0])
NMIN, KS = 30, 60
P["v"] = P.swn / P.sw * P.n / (P.n + KS); P.loc[P.n < NMIN, "v"] = 0.0
rows, mat = [], []
for pid, g in P.groupby("pid"):
    t = BT.get(pid); ok = KM[KM.type.isna() | (KM.type == t)]; gg = g.set_index("mid").reindex(ok.index)
    s = 100 * (gg.v.fillna(0) * ok.rr_wins_lost).sum() / ok.rr_wins_lost.sum()
    fixed = ok.rr_wins_lost[gg.v > 0].sum() / ok.rr_wins_lost.sum()
    best = (gg.v * ok.rr_wins_lost).sort_values(ascending=False); best = best[best > 0].index[:3]
    rows.append({"pid": pid, "bowler_type": t, "gap_score": s, "fixed_share": fixed, "moments_fixed": int((gg.v > 0).sum()), "moments_possible": len(ok),
                 "best_moments": ", ".join(f"{m} {KM.loc[m, 'label']}" for m in best)})
    for m in ok.index:
        r = gg.loc[m]
        mat.append({"pid": pid, "mid": m, "balls": 0 if pd.isna(r.n) else int(r.n), "runs_saved_per_100": None if pd.isna(r.n) or r.n < NMIN else round(100 * r.v, 1)})
S = pd.DataFrame(rows)
X = pd.read_csv(W / "final_rank.csv"); X = X[X.side == "bowling"][["pid", "name", "country", "status"]]
E = pd.read_csv(W / "evidence.csv"); E = E[E.side == "bowling"][["pid", "evidence", "evidence_ok"]] if "evidence" in E else E[E.side == "bowling"][["pid", "evidence_ok"]]
B = X.merge(S, on="pid", how="left").merge(E, on="pid", how="left")
old = {r["name"]: r for r in json.load(open("/home/claude/dash12/fix_top.json"))["rows"] if r["side"] == "Bowling"}
ev = {r["name"]: r["evidence"] for r in json.load(open("/home/claude/dash12/fix_top.json"))["rows"]}
F = pd.read_csv(W / "final_rank.csv"); F = F[F.side == "bowling"].set_index("pid")
B["old_final"] = B.pid.map(F.final)
evok = B.evidence_ok.fillna(False).astype(bool)
B["tier"] = np.select([evok & (B.gap_score > 0) & (B.fixed_share >= 0.2), evok & (B.gap_score > 0), B.gap_score > 0], [1, 2, 3], 4)
B = B.sort_values(["tier", "gap_score"], ascending=[True, False])
B["band"] = B.tier.map({1: "Proven: fixes several of RR's big gaps", 2: "Helps, but in too few of RR's gaps", 3: "Not proven by the evidence check", 4: "Doesn't fix RR's big gaps"})
buy = B[~B.status.isin(["RR 2027 squad", "Retained by another team"])]
out = []
for lst, src in (("Can buy", buy), ("Everyone", B)):
    a = src.head(10).copy(); a["rank"] = range(1, 11); a["list"] = lst; out.append(a)
TOP = pd.concat(out)
TOP["old_rank"] = [int((buy if l == "Can buy" else B).old_final.rank(ascending=False, method="first").loc[i]) for l, i in zip(TOP.list, TOP.index)]
B.to_csv(W / "bowl_gap_rank.csv", index=False)
M = pd.DataFrame(mat); M = M[M.pid.isin(TOP[TOP.list == "Can buy"].pid)].merge(TOP[TOP.list == "Can buy"][["pid", "name", "rank"]], on="pid")
M["moment"] = M.mid + " " + M.mid.map(KM.label); M["rr_wins_lost"] = M.mid.map(KM.rr_wins_lost)
BM = A[A.side == "bowling"].set_index("id").join(AM[["rr", "champ", "league", "rr2", "champ2", "league2", "rr_balls", "theme"]]).reset_index()
BM["why_dropped"] = np.where(BM.kept, "", "Champions are worse than the league here too")
def dump(name, df, inputs):
    rws = json.loads(df.replace({np.nan: None}).to_json(orient="records"))
    (O / f"{name}.json").write_text(json.dumps({"rows": rws, "meta": [{"label": "s47_bowl_gap_final.py", "value": CODE, "type": "code", "lang": "python"}, {"label": "Input", "value": inputs}]}))
    print(name, len(rws))
TOP["evidence"] = TOP.name.map(ev)
dump("bowl_top", TOP[["list", "rank", "name", "country", "status", "bowler_type", "band", "gap_score", "fixed_share", "moments_fixed", "moments_possible", "best_moments", "evidence", "old_final", "old_rank"]].round(3), "gap_parts_bowling.parquet (s46), final_rank.csv, evidence.csv")
dump("bowl_moments", BM[["id", "label", "theme", "kept", "why_dropped", "rr_wins_lost", "rr", "champ", "league", "rr2", "champ2", "league2", "rr_balls"]].round(2).sort_values("rr_wins_lost", ascending=False), "all_moments.csv, gap_moments.csv (s46)")
dump("bowl_matrix", M.sort_values(["rank", "rr_wins_lost"], ascending=[True, False])[["rank", "name", "mid", "moment", "rr_wins_lost", "balls", "runs_saved_per_100"]], "gap_parts_bowling.parquet (s46)")
pd.set_option("display.width", 250)
print(TOP[["list", "rank", "name", "bowler_type", "band", "gap_score", "fixed_share", "moments_fixed", "old_rank"]].round(2).to_string(index=False))
